notes: The page gives a scalar identity for ψ_Σ, asks for its image and asks whether all CM structures on K give a faithful family. The proof compares a structure with one embedding replaced by its complex conjugate. Check 151.N1: writing A=∏_{j≠i}σ_j(x), the two products are Aσ_i(x) and A barσ_i(x); their quotient is σ_i(x)/barσ_i(x). This verifies the local quotient step on units. The subsequent written quantifier is “∀ x”, although the preceding construction varies i, and the written conclusion is x=V′_{K_r}; both are retained literally. The norm equation describes the fibre of the norm at 1; the page’s equals sign between x and V′_{K_r} is recorded without replacement. No separate proof of the final arbitrary-algebra assertion was undertaken. The final cancelled sentence is unfinished. Archive number 150.
